Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
A couple of questions:

I graverob someones vamp. Later I manage to get it burned. Can I play DP
on it?
I guess no as I controlled it when it was burned.

Someone graverobs my vamp. Later I manage to burn it. Can I play DP on
it?
I guess no as I'm the owner of the ash-heap.

Metuselah A graverobs a vamp belonging to Metuselah B. I, being
Metuselah C
burns the vampire. Can I play DP on it?
I guess yes as it doesn't say that another controller also has to be the
owner of
the ash-heap.

Sten During

Sten During wrote:
>
> A couple of questions:
>
> I graverob someones vamp. Later I manage to get it burned. Can I play DP
> on it?
> I guess no as I controlled it when it was burned.

Correct.

> Someone graverobs my vamp. Later I manage to burn it. Can I play DP on
> it?
> I guess no as I'm the owner of the ash-heap.

Incorrect. Non-ownership of the ash heap is not a requirement given in card text.

> Metuselah A graverobs a vamp belonging to Metuselah B. I, being
> Metuselah C
> burns the vampire. Can I play DP on it?
> I guess yes as it doesn't say that another controller also has to be the
> owner of
> the ash-heap.

Correct.
